title: Retail CRM Team Leader (VLTs)
description:
We are #OPAP
We are Greece’s leading gaming company, with 65 years of history and Top Employer in Greece for 2023 & 2024. Our vision is to provide best-in-class entertainment in both retail and online, as well as to give back to society.
OPAP’s Fast Forward strategy guides our aspirations of delivering affordable and personalized entertainment experiences, while building an agile and dynamic company that enjoys long-term success. Customer centricity, digital orientation, agility, people engagement and social contribution are part of our DNA!
 
So what’s the challenge...
 
Are you ready to drive the transformation of customer relationships and boost engagement? As CRM Team Leader, you'll turn our Retail CRM Strategy into a dynamic and impactful plan that enhances customer value and engagement throughout their lifecycle.
 
Your day to day will include:
 

Implementing the CRM strategy for Retail Games to boost customer value and engagement
Collaborating with Sales, Product, Loyalty, and Retail Experience teams to align on roadmap and plan
Reviewing and refining the Retail CRM plan for mass and targeted campaigns, recommending audience segments, reward value, mechanisms, and channels, and finalizing the plan for approval
Designing automated lifecycle journeys (welcome, upsell, cross-sell, retention & reactivation) and offering tailored promotions at each stage
Proposing CRM plans utilizing new reward mechanisms (real-time triggers & missions) and conducting A/B testing
Analyzing the cost/benefit of the monthly CRM plan, including communication and OPEX budgets, in relation to targets
Monitoring and presenting performance against KPIs providing insights and proposing automations 
Optimizing campaign management operations to reduce human error and increase efficiency, team capacity, and agility

 
What you need to succeed: 
 

BSc in Business Administration, Marketing, Mathematics, or other relevant field
6+ years of hands-on experience in a similar role within a fast-paced organization 
Understanding of sophisticated customer segmentation & experience on defining segmented campaigns
Ability to understand the CRM ecosystem and data infrastructure 
Knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud or other CRM tools (Siebel CRM, Unica, Responsys, Optimove) is preferable
Team player with agility and adaptability 
Effective organizational and planning skills to deal with a variety of projects
People management skills
Business Acumen
Analytical skills with strong attention to detail 
Ability to work under pressure and deliver with high quality within strict timeframes
Strong communication and presentation skills both in Greek and English languages
Advanced MS Office skills, particularly in MS Excel

An award-winning working environment 🚀
State of the art facilities including gym & restaurant 🏢
Hybrid working model 💻
Competitive salary package and bonus scheme 💸
Health insurance coverage & Pension Plan 🙏

Internal Career Opportunities 💼
Well-Being Activities 💪

description:
